review:
A 5x3 carnival with three-row Harlequin xNudge wilds that land on any reel and nudge into view, +1 per step. In Harlequin Respins, those wilds walk one reel left each respin until they reach the first reel.

Three bonus symbols give eight Harlequin Bonus spins with a Harlequin wild locked in on reel 5 from x3. Walking xNudge wilds turn out to be a great combo. High volatility, 5,861x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
